name: Purupuri Oujira to Wagamamarashi Hime
original_name: ぷるぷる王子らとわがままらしい姫
source:
A charming lightweight novel game about the selfish princess of Garnadia and a couple of jiggly prince slimes.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134174.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款迷人的轻量级小说游戏，讲述了自私的加尔纳迪亚公主和几个摇摇晃晃的史莱姆王子的故事。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134174.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
